tags.target: cumulative phase shares q2-q5, q_k = sum(P_k..P5) / sum(P1..P5) from raw phase shares; QC: P1-P4 observed, a truly missing P5 = 0, every share finite in [0,1], exact total in [0.90,1.10], estimated_population ignored; phase = greatest k with q_k >= 0.20 (else 1); crisis = phase >= 3; evaluation rows include IPC validity copies (inherited: an existing IPC label copied to blank months of its analysis validity period) and Cadre Harmonise validity copies (new in this refit: an eligible current CH label copied to blank area-months of its reference window, source and destination in the same country), each counted once; fitting labels exclude every validity copy (final label_kind == original only), scoring keeps all rows
